item.title: WCO Presentation at the 6th WCO RTC Indonesia International Conference
item.description:
The 6th WCO RTC Indonesia International Conference was held in Jakarta on 20 and 21 October 2026, hosted by the Indonesian Customs and Excise Education and Training Center (ICEETC) as WCO Regional Training Centre Indonesia, under the theme “Customs Vigilance and Non-Tariff Measures”.

On behalf of the WCO, I delivered a virtual presentation in the Day 2 plenary on the topic “Artificial intelligence and machine learning for predictive supervision of prohibited goods”. The presentation covered four areas:

  • The changing border landscape
  • What AI and machine learning can do
  • Challenges and responsible use
  • How the WCO supports Members
